meanings.note: a door, a shop, or a legal case

examples.trans: The door is behind the wardrobe.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.trans: The main thing is, you keep him at home.

meanings.note: слава богу = thank God (literally 'glory to God')
at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
We have nobody to fear here.

уйти.gloss: to leave, to go away (on foot)

meanings.en: to leave, to go away, to walk out

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I love our town very much.

meanings.note: usually in short forms неправ, неправа, неправы

examples.text: Слушай, прости меня, я был неправ.
examples.trans: Listen, forgive me, I was wrong.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
+ infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

выгонять.gloss: to drive out, kick out, fire

meanings.en: to drive out, kick out, dismiss, fire

examples.trans: The chef fires the bartender from work.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

meanings.note: short forms знаком, знакома, знакомо, знакомы (+ dative)

examples.text: А знакомо ли тебе, Аркашка, слово педикюр?
examples.trans: And are you familiar, Arkashka, with the word pedicure?

examples.text: Я услышал в коридоре знакомый голос.
examples.trans: I heard a familiar voice in the corridor.

meanings.note: the noun after it is genitive plural: тысячи мест
after 2, 3, 4: года; after 5 and more: лет

examples.trans: I've been working here for four years.

examples.text: Это было давно, тридцать лет назад.
examples.trans: That was long ago, thirty years back.

всякий.gloss: every kind of, all sorts of, any

meanings.en: all sorts of, every kind of
meanings.note: всякое бывает = all sorts of things happen
на всякий случай = just in case

examples.trans: Alright, all sorts of things happen.
Take an umbrella just in case.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.
I wanted to ask you something.

meanings.note: просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness, apologise

examples.trans: He is asking me to forgive him.
Don't forget to wash the toilet.
I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.note: просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness
